project_info.theme: Luxury parent-appreciation fragrance duo gift idea
project_info.color_palette: White textured stone, amber gold, deep midnight blue, black, orange accents

main_subject.detail: A flat-lay style luxury fragrance duo image on a textured white surface. The left bottle is YSL Libre with amber juice and the engraved text 'THANK YOU MOM'. The right bottle is a dark Y Men fragrance with the text 'THANK YOU DAD'. Large bottom text reads 'LIBRE EDP & Y MEN EDP' and 'BỘ ĐÔI QUÀ TẶNG NÂNG TẦM ĐẲNG CẤP PHÓNG KHOÁNG & LỊCH LÃM'. A yellow heart with the YSL logo appears in the lower right.
main_subject.style: Luxury lifestyle product flat lay with clean modern surface and bold fragrance pairing

composition_elements.text: THANK YOU MOM; THANK YOU DAD; LIBRE EDP & Y MEN EDP; BỘ ĐÔI QUÀ TẶNG NÂNG TẦM ĐẲNG CẤP PHÓNG KHOÁNG & LỊCH LÃM
items: Top Left: Edge of a colorful graphic object entering the frame
Top Right: Edge of a matching graphic object and the dark Y Men bottle
Bottom Left: Large black headline and supporting Vietnamese copy over the white surface
Bottom Right: Yellow hand-drawn heart shape with the YSL monogram
Center/Background: Two angled perfume bottles on a textured white plaster-like tabletop, Libre on the left and Y Men on the right

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Strong clean shadows, glass reflections, crisp surface texture, editorial gift-guide clarity

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury gift-guide flat lay for YSL fragrances. Centerpiece is a photoreal textured white tabletop with two angled fragrance bottles: YSL Libre on the left engraved 'THANK YOU MOM' and a dark Y Men bottle on the right engraved 'THANK YOU DAD'. Include the exact text 'LIBRE EDP & Y MEN EDP' and 'BỘ ĐÔI QUÀ TẶNG NÂNG TẦM ĐẲNG CẤP PHÓNG KHOÁNG & LỊCH LÃM', plus a yellow heart with the YSL logo in the lower right. Technical style: photoreal luxury product flat-lay composite, bright directional flat-lay lighting, crisp shadows and editorial gift-guide clarity, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
